title: Go, Do and Can
objective: Say where you are going for breakfast, what you will order, and what you can do at a café.
focus: ir, ir a + infinitive for plans, hacer, and poder for asking permission

words.note: Where you order or sit on a stool in a café.
Where you pay; the person there is el cajero or la cajera.

words.en: I'm going to order the chilaquiles.
We're going to have breakfast here.
Can I sit on the terrace?
Do you make eggs to order?
words.note: Huevos al gusto: eggs cooked the way you like.

speaking: Tell a barista you are going to eat here, ask if you can sit on the terrace, and ask if you can pay by card.
